title: Put a new repo on qq

steps.say: A small Python repo with one test

steps.cmd: mkdir -p hello-qq/tests && cd hello-qq && git init -q && echo pytest > requirements-dev.txt && printf 'def test_adds():\n    assert 1 + 1 == 2\n' > tests/test_hello.py && ls -R
